label: late original-phase w in sequences starting with l
explanation: Sparse feature that fires only in the original phase (t=4..9, mostly orig_idx 5-8) and at the <DEL> step, never during copy. Its main trigger is the input token w at a late original position (t>=5). 74% of mass is on w inputs and 82% is in sequences whose first token is l; sequences starting with y are a weaker second group. The predicate l-first & w input & t>=5 & original phase has dev P=0.41, R=0.38, mass recall 0.55, and covers 67% of the top activation quartile. The weaker remainder includes the <DEL> step and other late tokens in l-initial sequences (in some cases next_out=l), plus late w in sequences starting with other letters. About 60% of the predicted steps stay inactive, and adding conditions on prev_tok or earlier digits did not separate them. No clear magnitude modulator was found beyond later position and the l-first context. The feature does not fire at t<4 or in the copy phase.
